description: ﻿﻿﻿Variation of condition 2 (Approved drawings) attached to planning permission ref 2025/0342 dated 18/07/2025 for the proposed development associated with change of use of first, second and third floors from Class E to two residential units (Class C3) involving first-floor rear extension and internal alterations. The variation would allow for the formation of a smoke vent to the stairway.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation, a Waste Management Plan detailing arrangements of council contracted street-side refuse collections as well as internal refuse bins integrated into the kitchens of the 2 x flats must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing. The development shall be implemented as per the approved details and retained like so.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development is in accordance with Hackney's refuse and waste policies.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; font-size: 14px;">No additional punctuations in the external walls and roofs shall be permitted other than as shown on the drawings hereby Approved except for roof punctuations required for an Automatic Opening Vent as per drawings 142_CHR_03_VC-A_801, 142_CHR_03_VC-P_801 and 142_CHR_03_VC-X_801.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; font-size: 14px;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building.</span></p>

<p>All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish, and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation details in the form of cross section drawings at a scale of 1:20 of the planters on the terrace must be provided showing a minimum depth of 0.5m as well as a planting plan incorporating a diverse mix of species, including native species beneficial to local wildlife; and a management and maintenance plan must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The development shall be implemented as per the approved details.</p><p>REASON: To enhance the character and ecology of the development, to provide undisturbed refuges for wildlife, and to promote sustainable urban drainage.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation of the development, details of obscured glazed screens at a height of 1.7m to the terrace shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be implemented as per the approved details.</p><p>REASON: To protect the privacy of neighbouring properties in Curtain and Charlotte Roads.</p>
